{
  "meta": {"title": "The Conviction Game", "author": "Dom Carroll"},
  "theme": {
    "bg": "#0d1117", "title_color": "#f0c040", "body_color": "#bbbbc2",
    "accent_color": "#e94560", "dim_color": "#737380",
    "title_font": "Montserrat", "body_font": "Open Sans", "mono_font": "Roboto Mono"
  },
  "frozen": {
    "thesis": "Collective intelligence from private conviction under quadratic cost, verified against ground truth",
    "concepts": ["Ground Truth", "Conviction", "Quadratic Cost", "Zero-Knowledge", "Anti-Collusion", "Social Deduction"],
    "financials": {"break_even": 4, "tiers": [0, 25, 100]},
    "audience": "Warwick - racing insider, NOT tech/crypto. Understands punters, tipsters, bookmakers, corporate boxes."
  },
  "slides": [
    {"id": "title", "layout": "center", "title": {"text": "THE CONVICTION GAME", "size": "3.2rem"}, "subtitle": "Rewilding the Punter Commons"},
    {"id": "every_sat", "layout": "title-body", "title": "Every Saturday...", "body": "Thousands of punters study the form.
They read the tip sheets.
They argue with their mates.
They develop private convictions.

Then they bet — individually —
into a system designed to take their money."},
    {"id": "intelligence", "layout": "center", "title": {"text": "Their collective intelligence
is extraordinary.", "color": "#ffffff"}, "subtitle": "It consistently outperforms any individual tipster.

But that intelligence is never captured.
Never aggregated.
Never returned to the people who generated it."},
    {"id": "problem_section", "layout": "section", "bg": "#170f0d", "title": {"text": "THE PROBLEM", "color": "#e94560"}},
    {"id": "thirty_two_b", "layout": "stat", "value": "$32B", "label": "Australian wagering market, annually", "body": "Three operators control it.
Sportsbet. Ladbrokes. TAB.

They are information extractors."},
    {"id": "flows_one_way", "layout": "title-body", "title": "Intelligence flows one way.", "body": "The punter commons existed.
In pubs. At the track. In WhatsApp groups.
Every gathering place where punters sit together.

Industrialised bookmaking enclosed it.
Not destroyed. Enclosed.

There’s just no venue that aggregates it honestly
and returns it to the people who generated it."},
    {"id": "pub_think", "layout": "center", "title": {"text": "What if the pub
could think?", "size": "2.8rem"}, "subtitle": {"text": "The WhatsApp group. The track. Any place punters gather.", "color": "#737380"}},
    {"id": "concepts_section", "layout": "section", "bg": "#110d19", "title": "SIX CONCEPTS", "subtitle": "Each one earns the next."},
    {"id": "ground_truth", "layout": "split", "num": "01", "title": {"text": "GROUND TRUTH", "color": "#f0c040"}, "body": "Horse racing delivers objective,
unchallengeable, publicly verifiable truth
every thirty minutes.

No committee decides.
The horse crossed the line first.", "sidebar": {"text": "~200
truth events
per week", "size": "2rem", "color": "#f0c040", "bold": true, "align": "center"}},
    {"id": "conviction", "layout": "title-body", "num": "02", "title": {"text": "CONVICTION", "color": "#f0c040"}, "body": "“I’m CERTAIN Horse 5 wins Race 3.”
“I THINK Horse 2 has a chance in Race 7.”
“Race 4? No idea.”

These are three different levels of conviction.
Every tipping platform treats them identically.

A conviction allocation captures the gradient.
The budget forces honesty about where you
actually have an edge."},
    {"id": "quadratic", "layout": "split", "num": "03", "title": {"text": "QUADRATIC COST", "color": "#f0c040"}, "body": "The cost of expressing conviction
grows as the square.

1 vote  =   1 credit
2 votes =   4 credits
3 votes =   9 credits
5 votes = 25 credits

Double the conviction.
Four times the cost.", "sidebar": {"text": "3.3×
more signal
from honesty", "size": "2.2rem", "color": "#f0c040", "bold": true, "align": "center"}},
    {"id": "zk", "layout": "title-body", "num": "04", "title": {"text": "ZERO-KNOWLEDGE PROOFS", "color": "#f0c040"}, "body": "Prove something is true
without revealing anything else.

“I am a member of this community”
— without revealing which member.

“I predicted Horse 5 would win”
— proved by opening a sealed envelope after the race.

“My track record is 34% strike rate”
— without revealing who I am."},
    {"id": "maci", "layout": "title-body", "num": "05", "title": {"text": "ANTI-COLLUSION", "color": "#f0c040"}, "body": "Five mates agree in a WhatsApp group:
“We’re all piling on Horse 3 to skew the signal.”

But any member can secretly change their vote.
And the ringleader can’t tell.

The override is invisible until the final tally.
The rational move is to silently defect
and vote honestly.

This doesn’t catch cartels.
It makes them impossible to coordinate."},
    {"id": "social_ded", "layout": "split", "num": "06", "title": {"text": "SOCIAL DEDUCTION", "color": "#f0c040"}, "body": "Games like Among Us
and Blood on the Clocktower:

Night phase — secret actions.
Day phase — public discussion.

Some players are honest.
Some are lying.
Nobody knows who.

The drama is emergent.
That IS the engagement.", "sidebar": {"text": "Punters who
would never care
about ZK proofs

WILL care about
catching someone
gaming the system.", "size": "1rem", "color": "#e94560", "bold": true, "align": "center"}},
    {"id": "synthesis_section", "layout": "section", "bg": "#110d19", "title": "THE SYNTHESIS", "subtitle": "Six concepts. One system."},
    {"id": "closed_loop", "layout": "title-body", "title": "The Closed System", "body": "Ground Truth  →  provides the exam for
    Conviction  →  priced by
        Quadratic Cost  →  protected by
            Zero-Knowledge  →  hardened by
                Anti-Collusion  →  experienced as
                    Social Deduction  →  validated by
                        Ground Truth  ←  the loop closes"},
    {"id": "thirty_min", "layout": "title-body", "title": "The 30-Minute Cycle", "body": "NIGHT  —  Allocate conviction. Private. Simultaneous. Hidden.

DAWN  —  Race runs. Ground truth arrives. Credits settle.

DAY   —  Forensics. Patterns surface. “Unusual concentration in Race 4.”

DUSK  —  Discussion. Who called it? Voluntary reveals.

↻  Repeat. 8–10 times per meeting."},
    {"id": "honesty", "layout": "center", "title": {"text": "Honesty is the dominant strategy
after ~20 races.", "color": "#ffffff"}, "subtitle": {"text": "This isn’t an aspiration.
It’s a mathematical property of the mechanism.", "color": "#737380"}},
    {"id": "game_section", "layout": "section", "bg": "#110d19", "title": "THE GAME", "subtitle": "What it feels like to play."},
    {"id": "saturday", "layout": "title-body", "title": "A Saturday Inside", "body": "MORNING   Tip sheets arrive. AI extracts data.
          Study form. Allocate conviction.

RACE 1    Allocations close 5 min before.
          Race runs. Ground truth. Credits settle.

BETWEEN   Forensics surface. Community discusses.
          “Unusual pattern in Race 1.” Who called it?

RACE 2    The loop repeats. 8–10 times per meeting.

EVENING   Daily stats. Leaderboard moves."},
    {"id": "archetypes", "layout": "grid-2x2", "title": "Four Kinds of Player", "cells": [{"title": "THE ANALYST", "body": "Studies form obsessively.
Lives for the leaderboard.
Wants to prove they’re the best."}, {"title": "THE PUNTER", "body": "Hunches. Longshots.
The thrill of the unlikely call.
Finds overlays nobody else saw."}, {"title": "THE SOCIALISER", "body": "Lives in chat.
Community IS the product.
Belonging over winning."}, {"title": {"text": "THE SHARK", "color": "#e94560"}, "body": "Hunts anomaly patterns.
Exposes manipulation.
The immune system."}]},
    {"id": "shark", "layout": "center", "title": {"text": "The Shark doesn’t exist
on any tipping platform today.", "color": "#ffffff"}, "subtitle": "Social deduction creates the Shark archetype.
Catching someone gaming the system is genuinely fun.

The Shark is the immune system.
And they play for free."},
    {"id": "box_section", "layout": "section", "bg": "#170f0d", "title": {"text": "THE DIGITAL
CORPORATE BOX", "size": "2.8rem"}, "subtitle": "Your punters are already at the track.
We built the boxes."},
    {"id": "tiers", "layout": "grid-2x2", "title": "Three Seats at the Track", "cells": [{"title": {"text": "GRANDSTAND", "color": "#737380"}, "body": "Free • WhatsApp

Race fields, consensus tips, results.

You can see the race from the hill."}, {"title": {"text": "MEMBERS", "color": "#ffffff"}, "body": "$25/mo • Matrix

Full conviction game, leaderboard,
forensics, community chat.

Inside the fence."}, {"title": {"text": "BOX SEAT", "color": "#f0c040"}, "body": "$100/mo • Premium

Personal AI swarm tuned to your form.
Advanced analytics.

Your name on the door."}, {"title": "", "body": ""}]},
    {"id": "breakeven", "layout": "center", "title": {"text": "Break-even at
4 paying users.", "size": "2.8rem"}, "subtitle": {"text": "Infrastructure costs: $22–100/month.
The business is essentially unkillable on a cash basis.", "color": "#737380"}},
    {"id": "bookmaker_box", "layout": "split", "title": "Every Bookmaker Gets Their Own Box", "body": "Same track. Same races.
Different box. Different brand.

The bookmaker doesn’t build
the racecourse.
They lease a box.

Marginal cost per new box → near zero.
Boxes compete on race day.", "sidebar": {"text": "“Which box called
more winners?”

Sportsbet’s box: 7 of 10.
Ladbrokes’ box: 5.

That’s content.
That’s tribal identity.", "size": "1rem", "color": "#e94560", "bold": true, "align": "center"}},
    {"id": "moat_section", "layout": "section", "bg": "#110d19", "title": "THE MOAT", "subtitle": "Five layers. Each reinforces the others."},
    {"id": "five_layers", "layout": "title-body", "title": "Five Layers Deep", "body": "1.  THE ROOM
     The people inside each box.
     Can’t clone a WhatsApp group. Can’t manufacture pub trust.

2.  DATA
     Months of conviction-vs-truth. Can’t fake. Can’t generate retroactively.

3.  MECHANISM
     QV + ZK + MACI. 12–18 months to replicate.

4.  PERSONAL SWARMS
     Co-evolved with each punter. Non-transferable.

5.  THE VIEW ACROSS ALL BOXES
     Cross-community signal. Exclusively ours.
     Only the box-builder does."},
    {"id": "asymmetry", "layout": "split", "title": {"text": "The Asymmetry", "align": "center"}, "body": {"text": "DOWNSIDE
$50–100/month
in infrastructure", "color": "#737380", "align": "center"}, "sidebar": {"text": "UPSIDE
The racecourse
in a $32B market", "size": "1.3rem", "color": "#f0c040", "bold": true, "align": "center"}},
    {"id": "ask", "layout": "center", "title": {"text": "The game doesn’t need
to be explained.", "color": "#ffffff", "size": "2.5rem"}, "subtitle": {"text": "It needs to be played.

Let’s build it.

Want a box with your logo on it?", "color": "#f0c040"}}
  ]
}
